div.style: margin-top: 12px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04), 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02); border: 1px solid #eef2f5; overflow: hidden; background: #ffffff;

table.style: margin-bottom: 0; font-family: 'Outfit', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0;

th.t-att-style: 'text-align: right; font-weight: 600; color: #495057; font-size: 0.85rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; border-bottom: 2px solid #eaedf1; padding: 14px 18px;' if is_number(f, (data and data[0] or {}).get(f)) else 'text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: #495057; font-size: 0.85rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; border-bottom: 2px solid #eaedf1; padding: 14px 18px;'

td.div: Try adjusting your filters, double-checking the dates, or widening your search bounds.

td.t-att-style: 'text-align: right; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding: 12px 18px; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #2c3e50; border-bottom: 1px solid #f2f4f7;' if is_number(f, row.get(f)) else 'text-align: left; padding: 12px 18px; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #34495e; border-bottom: 1px solid #f2f4f7;'
